issues.title: req.body used without schema validation
issues.message: req.body property accessed without visible schema validation in surrounding context.
issues.snippet: const email = req.body.email; // VULN: no email format validation
issues.remediation: Use Zod (z.object({}).parse(req.body)), Joi, or express-validator to validate the request body.

issues.title: req.params used without validation
issues.message: Route parameter accessed without type coercion or validation.
issues.snippet: const id = req.params.id; // VULN: no type coercion (VAL003)
issues.remediation: Validate route params: IDs should use parseInt() or UUID validation before DB queries.

issues.title: req.query used without sanitization
issues.message: Query string parameter used without validation or type coercion.
issues.snippet: const q = req.query.q; // VULN: no query validation (VAL004)
issues.remediation: Validate query parameters with express-validator or Zod .query() schemas.

issues.title: File upload without MIME type validation
issues.message: File upload detected without visible MIME type or extension validation.
issues.remediation: Validate file MIME types using fileFilter in multer and verify magic bytes server-side.

issues.title: Email field not validated
issues.message: Email field used without format validation.
issues.snippet: const email = req.body.email; // VULN: no email format validation
issues.remediation: Validate email format with z.string().email(), Joi.string().email(), or @IsEmail().

issues.title: Object.assign / spread with unvalidated input
issues.message: Merging req.body directly into objects risks prototype pollution.
issues.snippet: Object.assign(userSettings, req.body); // VULN: spread of unvalidated req.body
issues.remediation: Validate and destructure only known properties from req.body before merging.

issues.title: Unbounded pagination limit
issues.message: Pagination limit taken from user input without upper bound — DoS risk.
issues.snippet: const limit = req.query.limit; // VULN: no max cap
